verdict.rationale: INPI's own pages present filing as an online transaction: the patent-filing page is titled "Dépôt de brevet en ligne" (online patent filing), and e-Soleau, an electronic deposit, has its own filing page. Trademark and design filing also have dedicated 'déposer' procedure pages. The evidence is only page titles, though, and gives no detail of the online flow. missing for 10: explicit statement that trademark and design filings are completed online, evidence of online fee payment, hands-on or independent corroboration of the end-to-end online filing flow.
